review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: The structure of interleukin-2 complexed with its alpha receptor
decision_basis: The common-gamma receptor reviews identify IL-2Ralpha as the high-affinity capture subunit, and the cited structure directly resolves human IL-2 bound to IL-2Ralpha.
limitations_preserved: Direct binary IL-2Ralpha binding only; preserve stepwise assembly and do not treat CD25 as the signaling subunit or infer CNS/SCI context.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Crystal structure of the IL-2 signaling complex: paradigm for a heterotrimeric cytokine receptor; Structure of the quaternary complex of interleukin-2 with its alpha, beta, and gammac receptors
decision_basis: The reviews describe stepwise gamma-chain receptor assembly, and the cited primary structures resolve IL-2 with IL-2Ralpha, IL-2Rbeta, and common-gamma ectodomains in a signaling complex.
limitations_preserved: Soluble ectodomain assembly/stoichiometry; preserve the alpha-beta-gamma chain topology and do not infer native cell-surface avidity or SCI receiver weighting.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC6237706, JAK/STAT signaling review
primary_title: Delineation of the regions of interleukin-2 receptor beta chain important for association of Jak1 and Jak3; Involvement of proteasomes in regulating Jak-STAT pathways upon interleukin-2 stimulation
decision_basis: The reviews place JAK1 and JAK3 on gamma-chain receptor signaling, and the cited primary studies show IL-2Rbeta/gammac-associated JAK recruitment and IL-2-induced JAK1/JAK3 activation.
limitations_preserved: JAK association/activation layer rather than direct IL-2-to-JAK binding; preserve receptor-subunit dependence and do not infer a universal kinase hierarchy outside tested systems.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC6237706, JAK/STAT signaling review
primary_title: Activation of Stat5 by interleukin 2 requires a carboxyl-terminal region of the interleukin 2 receptor beta chain; Janus kinases in interleukin-2-mediated signaling
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT5 as a canonical IL-2 gamma-chain output, and the cited primary studies show IL-2-induced STAT5 activation requiring functional JAK1/JAK3-associated receptor components.
limitations_preserved: Bound to STAT5 relay in IL-2 receptor systems; no terminal-TF or SCI claim beyond the recorded pathway output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Crystal structure of the interleukin-4/receptor alpha chain complex reveals a mosaic binding interface; Crystals of a 1:1 complex between human interleukin-4 and the extracellular domain of its receptor alpha chain
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-4Ralpha as the high-affinity capture subunit, and the cited primary crystallographic studies directly resolve human IL-4 bound to IL-4Ralpha.
limitations_preserved: Direct binary capture-subunit binding only; preserve subsequent common-gamma recruitment and do not conflate IL4Ralpha with the type-II IL-4/IL-13 receptor topology.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Molecular and structural basis of cytokine receptor pleiotropy in the interleukin-4/13 system; The interleukin-4 site-2 epitope determining binding of the common receptor gamma chain; An antagonistic mutant of interleukin-4 fails to recruit gamma c into the receptor complex
decision_basis: The reviews describe the type-I IL-4 receptor as IL-4Ralpha plus common gamma chain, and the cited primary studies resolve the ternary type-I complex or demonstrate ligand-dependent gamma-chain recruitment.
limitations_preserved: Type-I IL-4 receptor branch only; preserve the distinct IL-4Ralpha/IL-13Ralpha1 type-II branch and membrane assembly semantics.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6584916, Slit/Robo signaling review; PMCID:PMC4765433, Axon Growth and Guidance review
primary_title: Slit proteins bind Robo receptors and have an evolutionarily conserved role in repulsive axon guidance; SLIT2-mediated ROBO2 signaling restricts kidney induction to a single site; SLIT2/ROBO2 signaling pathway inhibits nonmuscle myosin IIA activity and destabilizes kidney podocyte adhesion
decision_basis: The reviews map SLIT2 to ROBO2, and the cited primary studies support Slit2-Robo2-dependent developmental signaling plus receptor-dependent podocyte adhesion responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve proteolytic Slit2 processing, Robo2-specific developmental/podocyte contexts, and shared Robo-family caveats; no CNS/SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC9282903, Sema3A neuropilin/plexin review; PMCID:PMC4765433, Axon Growth and Guidance review
primary_title: Neuropilin is a receptor for the axonal chemorepellent Semaphorin III; Characterization of neuropilin-1 structural features that confer binding to semaphorin 3A and vascular endothelial growth factor 165; Structure of the semaphorin 3A receptor binding module
decision_basis: The reviews identify NRP1 as the ligand-binding subunit of Sema3A receptor complexes, and the cited primary studies show high-affinity Sema3A-NRP1 binding with interface mapping and mutational validation.
limitations_preserved: Direct ligand-binding subunit edge only; preserve NRP1/plexin receptor-complex requirement for productive signaling and do not treat NRP1 as a catalytic receptor.
